conditions: The Appodeal SDK 3.2.1 and above is fully compatible with Google UMP and supports IAB TCF v2.
Only users based in the EU are prompted with consent forms.
effects: Allows SDK to deliver ads that are more relevant to the users based on their consent.
Consent is requested automatically on SDK initialization and the consent form is shown without any additional calls.
Can update and manage consent using Stack Consent Manager calls, check current consent status, load consent form, show consent form.

conditions: ConsentUpdateRequestParameters data class is used to encapsulate the necessary information for updating consent preferences.

Parameters needed for a consent update request using Appodeal Consent Manager: activity (Activity in which the consent update is requested), key (The key associated with the user for whom the consent is being updated), tagForUnderAgeOfConsent(Optional, Indicates whether the user is tagged for under the age of consent.), sdk (Optional, Identifier for the SDK making the consent update request), sdkVersion (Optional, Version of the SDK making the consent update request).
effects: Allows the Appodeal SDK to update the user's consent status.
